description_en: Queries the list of nodes that use a specific join permission based on filter conditions by calling ListNodesByOwnedJoinPermissionId
description_zh: 调用ListNodesByOwnedJoinPermissionId根据过滤条件，查询使用了特定入网凭证的节点列表
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan list-nodes-by-owned-join-permission-id --iot-instance-id example-string --join-permission-id 123 --fuzzy-dev-eui d896e0 --offset 0 --limit 2 --sorting-field CREATED_MILLIS --ascending true --api-version 2019-03-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNodesByOwnedJoinPermissionId

parameters.help_en: The DevEUI used to fuzzy match nodes
parameters.name: fuzzy_dev_eui

parameters.help_en: The offset of the query, starting from 0
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的起始位置，从0开始
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of nodes to return in this query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的节点数量上限，大于等于1
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The sorting field. Set the value to **CREATED_MILLIS** to sort by creation time
parameters.help_zh: 指定排序字段，可取值为**CREATED_MILLIS**, 表示根据创建时间排序
parameters.name: sorting_field

parameters.help_en:

- **false**: descending order
